verdict.rationale: Exa documents a dedicated Contents API that returns clean page content from URLs, including JavaScript-rendered pages and PDFs. The same contents features are available inline in Search results (free up to 10 results per search), and Search is described as returning clean page content in one request, not just excerpts. Community users refer to page text being returned and fed to LLMs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a markdown output format, an explicit full-text parameter or response field, and independent confirmation that complete (non-truncated) page text is returned.
